title: Why some people escape Alzheimer’s despite carrying a high-risk gene
caption:
Scientists have uncovered why some people with a high genetic risk for Alzheimer's stay mentally sharp. A rare mutation prevents a specific protein from damaging the brain's blood-brain barrier, offering a new potential target for future therapies.

Source: Sciencedaily - Why some people escape Alzheimer’s despite carrying a high-risk gene

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261018205044.htm
